caption:
How to turn customer reviews into social posts with AI (with permission)

Your best reviews are sitting on a page nobody reads. One prompt turns each one into a post, without changing a word the customer wrote.

Copy this:

"Here's a customer review: [PASTE REVIEW]. Write a short social post that quotes it word for word, adds one line about the job, and ends with a soft invite. Don't change their words. First name + initial only."

Before you post, ask: "Can we share your review on our page, with your first name?" Screenshot the yes and keep it.

Two checks: the quote must match the original exactly, and the extra line must be true about your business.

Send this to someone who still copies reviews by hand. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.

Save this for later. 📌
